about: Gate-board rows that are honestly not PROVEN, acknowledged by adjudication 2026-10-04 (option b). Each entry pins the measured state; a re-run that is WORSE (lower n_proven, a worse state, a new failing subject) breaches drift_guard; a row now PROVEN asks for its entry to be removed. Adding an entry needs a recorded adjudication; removing one is always allowed. An acknowledged row is NOT a pass: P0-3 acceptance stays NOT MET until this list is empty. Evidence: docs/GATE_BOARD.md.

entries.reason: 4x down-up of the output moves LPIPS only 0.037 -> 0.059 on the soft low-res source coven-ashe (1192x670 -> 2560); LPIPS at 0.12 is blind to that detail loss there. Ladder coverage holds: G1.lap_ratio catches the same fault on coven-ashe (1.514 -> 0.198, FAIL).
entries.clears_when: G1.lpips PROVEN 12/12 under downup_x4 (fault NOT rescaled to suit the gate)
entries.adjudication: 2026-10-04 adjudicator Q2: accept BROKEN, do not rescale or NA the subject
